title: B1 DATASET + SAR VALIDATION REPORT
notes: Per-file percentiles estimated on stride-4 subsample; global percentiles from capped random reservoir (documented sampling). Display stretch in QC figures is display-only; sources untouched.

5_pairing.convention: flat masks share exact basename with images (00000.tif <-> 00000.tif); nested Mask/<class>/*_segmentation.tif is a separate 150-file subset, NOT filename-matched to flat images

8_sar_polarization.evidence: 2 x float32 bands, no VV/VH/HH/HV tags in TIFF metadata; band_tags empty; see band_tags sample in per-file records. metadata hits: []

9_sar_representation.evidence: float32 values, strongly negative (approx -55..0 dB-like) in train Oil/No_oil/Lookalike; test Oil shows positives up to ~+7. No sigma0/gamma0/amplitude/dB tags found; range alone is insufficient evidence. See per-band stats.

16_alignment: Masks carry no CRS/transform (identity); pixel-level alignment validated via paired dimensions; geospatial alignment cannot be independently verified from mask metadata.

17_duplicates.method: basename match + (file-size, 32x32 stride-64 band-1 thumbnail md5)

18_leakage.note: No split performed; scene-level IDs unavailable in metadata.

23_manual_review: 1443 basenames exist in >1 location (flat train vs nested Mask/ vs test) -> expected by layout, verify split hygiene later
450 test files share basenames with train -> REQUIRES REVIEW (possible leakage)
SAR representation: REPRESENTATION COULD NOT BE CONFIRMED from metadata
Nested Mask/<class>/*_segmentation.tif (150/class) foreground rates differ strongly from flat masks; confirm which mask set is authoritative before training
EXACT duplicates verified: Oil/00007==Oil/01339 (same image, DIFFERENT masks fg 70772 vs 74906) -> REQUIRES REVIEW
EXACT duplicates verified: Oil/00356==Oil/00357 (image+mask identical); No_oil/00542==00543 -> REQUIRES REVIEW
Odd dims: 4 Lookalike files differ from 2048x2048 (00140, 00166, 00288, 00390) -> handle before tiling
Extreme minima (band1 <= -112, several with max exactly 0.0) -> REQUIRES REVIEW

25_exact_duplicate_verification.method: exact np.array_equal on full float32 rasters (read-only)

exact_duplicates.verdict: SAME IMAGE, DIFFERENT MASKS - REQUIRES REVIEW (label inconsistency / leakage risk)

25_exact_duplicate_verification.note_zeros: ~49% of train images contain some >=0 px (bright scatterers up to +29); reservoir P99~=0 reflects heavy-tailed positives. Files with max exactly 0.0 + extreme negative minima suggest dark/outlier scenes.
